name: deployment_agent
description: Release operations specialist. Checks release readiness, runs compliance scans, raises human change-approval tickets and drives deployment jobs for services owned by the platform team. Pauses for a human decision before any production release.

skills.name: Release readiness check
skills.description: Reports whether a given service version can be released into an environment: open incidents, service tier, owning team, assessed risk and whether a human change approval is required.
examples: Check release readiness for search-indexer 0.9.1 in staging

skills.name: Pre-release compliance scan
skills.description: Runs the SOC2/PCI control scan for a service before release. Takes tens of seconds; the A2A task stays in the working state for the whole scan and streams progress.
examples: Run the compliance scan for billing-worker in production

skills.name: Human change approval
skills.description: Opens a change-approval ticket and pauses the task in the input-required state until a human approves or rejects it. The pending approval is surfaced to the caller as a long-running function call that must be answered with a function response on the same task.

skills.name: Deployment execution
skills.description: Runs a canary deployment pipeline that outlives a single request. Returns a job handle immediately and parks the task in the input-required state until the terminal job result is delivered back as a function response.
examples: Roll out checkout-api 2.14.0 now that CHG-1234 is approved
